hostname ix-v01
!
ip route default 203.0.113.1
!
ip dhcp-relay enable
!
bridge irb enable
!
device GigaEthernet2
  vlan-group 1 port 1 2
  vlan-group 3 port 3 4
  vlan-group 5 port 5
  port 3 speed 100
  port 3 duplex full
  port 4 shutdown
!
interface BVI0
  description sample office
  ip address 192.0.2.1/25
  ip dhcp-relay server 198.51.100.67
  bridge-group 10
  no shutdown
!
interface BVI1
  ip address 192.0.2.129/25
  bridge-group 20
  no shutdown
!

  description sample wan
  ip address 203.0.113.2/30
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2:1.0
  bridge-group 10
  no shutdown
!

  bridge-group 20
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2:5.0
  no shutdown
!
